codeReview.summary: The implementation perfectly matches the requirements. The settings screen was successfully migrated to use the shared UI primitives (Card, Input, Switch, Button) and NativeWind classes. All requested sections (profile, calendar preferences, calendars list, timezone, and account actions) are present and properly connected to the shared calendar data and API service. No hardcoded styles or colors remain. Error handling and loading states are accounted for.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker spent time grepping through packages/calendar-client to discover the calendarApiService methods (getUserSettings, updateUserSettings) and UserSettings types. Documenting core API services and data structures in the library could speed up development.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows multiple Grep and Read calls targeting packages/calendar-client/src/api.ts and types.ts to figure out how to fetch and update settings.

summary: Review passed. The mobile settings screen was successfully rewritten using unified Tailwind classes and shared UI primitives, fulfilling all requirements.
